fact: The Conseil Supérieur's atlas of 2019 states that MASSAR, adopted in 2013 as a school management system for all public and private establishments from pre-primary to upper secondary and built on a unique pupil identifier, has an assessment component in which more than 260 million assessment marks are stored in a single database in one semester of each school year and more than 6.5 million report cards are produced from it, with parents able to consult their children's marks online; it also covers enrolment, re-enrolment, transfers and the management of school time. The atlas gives no count of schools entering marks.
title: Atlas territorial de l'abandon scolaire : analyse des parcours de la cohorte 2014-2018 et cartographie communale
publisher: Conseil Supérieur de l'Éducation, de la Formation et de la Recherche Scientifique
